_: Declared exceptions for scripts/check_dead_surface.py. An entry here says
'this is unreachable ON PURPOSE and here is why', and it removes the item
from the count entirely rather than pinning it in the baseline. Use it only
for something that is unreachable BY DESIGN. Anything that is merely not
deleted yet belongs in dead_surface_baseline.json, where it stays visible.
check_ratchets_not_loosened.py blocks edits to this file inside a review.

backend_modules_allowed.scripts.mint_app_token: Command-line entry point run by hand (backend/.venv/bin/python backend/scripts/mint_app_token.py) to mint a scoped service token into a runner app's env store; nothing imports it by design.
backend_modules_allowed.scripts.local_turn_guard: PreToolUse hook command the CLI runs for a turn on a local model (services/local_turn builds the --settings that names it); nothing imports it by design.

api_areas_not_called_from_the_repo.plaid: Inbound webhook. Plaid calls it; nothing in this repo does, and nothing should.
